newsitem.title: USA: Caldor gets $450 mln facility extension.
newsitem.headline: Caldor gets $450 mln facility extension.

text.p: Caldor Corp, which is undergoing Chapter 11 bankrupty proceedings, said Friday it received a commitment for the extension of a $450 milllion facility through June 15, subject to court approval.
The company said the debtor-in-possession facility is being provided by its bank lenders led by Chase Manhattan Bank, a unit of Chase Manhattan Corp.

Warren Feldberg, chairman and chief executive officer of Caldor, said the extension of the facility provides significant liquidity as the company moves ahead with its plans to return to profitability.
He said Caldor is refocusing its strategies as a full-line, upscale discount retailer and is making solid progress in achieving the goals set forth in its business plan.
Caldor, with annual sales of approximately $2.6 billion, currently operates 157 stores in ten East Coast and Mid-Atlantic states.
